descriptions.accounts: Current account password, API tokens, and admin user maintenance.
descriptions.fanbox: FANBOX archiving by creator or link. Images and attachments join the gallery; body and engagement become posts. Sessions can be derived from a Pixiv cookie.
descriptions.dashboard: Role-aware summary of available admin entries.
descriptions.developer: Backend config editing, node status, and developer maintenance actions.
descriptions.maintenance: Database rebuilds, media cache generation, and cloud storage settings.
descriptions.misskey: Misskey archiving, access token credentials, and sync logs. Media joins the gallery, text becomes posts.
descriptions.operations: Upload history, transcode queue, and recent upload logs.
descriptions.pixiv: Pixiv sync, OAuth/Token/Cookie credentials, and sync logs.
descriptions.security: Security toggles, rate limits, access logs, and role/user quotas.
descriptions.tags: Tag aliases, tag summary filters, and summary exports.
descriptions.x: X archiving by link or by user. Media joins the gallery; text, metrics and tags become posts.

stageDetails.encoding_thumb: Preview is complete; generating the AVIF thumbnail.
stageDetails.encoding_webp: Writing the animated WebP preview. This encoder saves in one pass, so progress jumps to the thumbnail stage after it finishes.
stageDetails.reading_frames: Reading, transposing, and resizing frames; fps is the current preprocessing speed.
stageDetails.waiting: Waiting for the next progress update.

misskey.hostHint: Defaults to misskey.io. Self-hosted can use http://misskey.lan:3000.
misskey.maxPagesHint: Leave empty to walk to the end.
misskey.noSavedToken: Do not use a saved token
misskey.note: Media is archived as regular gallery assets; note text is stored as posts and shown on the posts page.
misskey.syncDescription: Archive a user's notes. Media becomes regular gallery assets and text is stored as posts. Re-running only fetches new notes and keeps backfilling older ones.
misskey.tokenMissing: No access token available. Save one on the right, or set [misskey].token in the config.
misskey.tokensDescription: Save multiple account tokens and switch between them per run. Tokens are encrypted at rest and shown masked.
misskey.usernameHint: Use noa for local users, noa@example.social for remote ones.

x.delayHint: X rate limits aggressively; keep at or above 2.
x.maxPagesHint: Leave empty to walk to the end.
x.noSavedToken: Do not use a saved session
x.note: Photos and videos are archived as regular gallery assets at original quality; post text, metrics and tags become posts shown on the posts page. Single public posts resolve without credentials; timeline sync needs a saved auth_token/ct0 session.
x.sessionRequired: Walking a timeline needs a signed-in session. Save an auth_token/ct0 pair on the right, or set [x].auth_token and [x].ct0.
x.syncDescription: Archive X posts into the gallery. Photos and videos are stored as regular assets at original quality; text, likes/reposts and tags become a post. Re-running only fetches what is new.
x.targetsHint: One link per line, or separated by commas, semicolons or pipes. Single public posts need no credentials.
x.tokenHelp: In a browser signed in to x.com open DevTools > Application > Cookies and copy auth_token and ct0.
x.tokensDescription: Save several account sessions and switch between them per run. Stored encrypted and shown masked.
x.usernameHint: The handle after @, for example NyaGallery.

fanbox.creator: Creator id
fanbox.creatorHint: The id after @, or paste the creator URL, e.g. nekoworks.
fanbox.loginHint: FANBOX accepts neither a Pixiv cookie nor a refresh_token, but its login redirects through the Pixiv account. Leave empty to use the configured [pixiv].cookie. Needs the optional pixiv-login dependency.
fanbox.maxPagesHint: Leave empty to walk to the end.
fanbox.noSavedSession: Do not use a saved session
fanbox.note: Post images and attachments are archived as regular gallery assets; title, body, tags and like/comment counts become a post. FANBOX cannot reuse Pixiv credentials directly, but a saved Pixiv session can be exchanged for a FANBOXSESSID; reading post bodies always requires that session.
fanbox.pixivCookiePlaceholder: Pixiv cookie (empty uses the configured one)
fanbox.sessionRequired: Without a FANBOX session only public summaries are readable — no post bodies and no media. Exchange a Pixiv cookie on the right, or paste a FANBOXSESSID.
fanbox.sessionsDescription: Save several sessions and switch between them per run. Stored encrypted and shown masked.
fanbox.syncDescription: Archive FANBOX posts into the gallery. Images and attachments are stored as regular assets; title, body, tags and engagement become a post. Re-running only fetches what is new.
fanbox.targetsHint: One link per line, or separated by commas, semicolons or pipes.

accounts.developerCreateHint: Developer accounts can only be created by an existing developer or the local CLI.
accounts.existingUsersHint: Regular users can be reset here; admin/developer passwords must be changed by the account owner above or through the developer console.
accounts.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
accounts.privilegedPasswordHint: Privileged account passwords can only be changed by the account owner or through the developer console

developer.configSaved: Config written; restart the backend for full effect
developer.consoleDescription: Multi-node backend listing is reserved; this currently exposes local developer maintenance actions.
developer.consoleDisabled: Developer console is disabled. Enable console_enabled in config and restart the backend.
developer.consoleWarning: The web console is restricted to allowlisted maintenance actions.
developer.enterUserAndPassword: Enter a username and new password
developer.networkHint: Proxy profiles store the server URL in plain text. Enable proxy_auth only when the proxy requires credentials; proxy passwords are encrypted when a deployment key is present.
developer.proxyPasswordConfigured: This proxy password is configured. Leave it empty to keep the current value, or enter a new password to replace and encrypt it.
developer.saveWarning: Saving rewrites the TOML file. Most settings need a backend restart to fully apply. Empty secret_key, Pixiv token/cookie, and proxy password fields keep their old values; saving auto-generates secret_key when it is missing.
developer.secretHint: The deployment key encrypts Pixiv credentials, proxy passwords, and cloud storage credentials. Setup pre-generates it; multi-instance deployments must use the same value on every backend.

storageStrategy.name: Name
storageStrategy.nameHint: Unique identifier used to select this storage strategy.
storageStrategy.typeHint: Storage backend implementation used to save original media.
storageStrategy.prefixHint: Top-level path prefix for files in this strategy, such as original.
storageStrategy.rootPathHint: Local directory or remote drive folder used as the storage root.
storageStrategy.timeoutSecondsHint: Maximum time to wait for one storage operation.
storageStrategy.endpointHint: Service endpoint URL. Leave blank when the backend uses its default endpoint.
storageStrategy.regionHint: Object storage region; leave blank if the provider does not require one.
storageStrategy.accessKeyIdHint: Public identifier for the object storage access key.
storageStrategy.accessKeySecretHint: Secret part of the object storage access key.
storageStrategy.tokenHint: Access token or API token used by the storage provider.
storageStrategy.usernameHint: Account username used by the storage provider.
storageStrategy.passwordHint: Account password used by the storage provider.

maintenance.brandingDescription: Site name and logo. Reload the page after saving.
maintenance.cloudDescription: Config writes to nyagallery.toml; restart the backend after saving for full effect.
maintenance.developerOnly: Cloud storage config is only available to the developer role.
maintenance.developerOnlyHint: This account can run maintenance tasks, but cannot edit cloud storage strategies. Use a developer account on this page.
maintenance.emptyStrategies: No cloud storage strategies yet; only local is used.
maintenance.encryptionDisabled: Deployment key is not enabled: cloud storage password/token/access_key_secret values are only masked in the UI and are not encrypted when written to TOML. Saving config will auto-generate security.secret_key.
maintenance.encryptionEnabled: Deployment key is enabled: cloud storage password/token/access_key_secret values are encrypted in TOML and only masked in the UI.
maintenance.logoUrlHint: A site path such as /logo.png, or a full external URL. Leave empty to show the initial instead.
maintenance.maxVideoSizeHint: During a sync, videos above this size fall back to a lower-quality source; if every source is over the limit the video is skipped. Use 0 for no limit.
maintenance.namePostId: Name archived files by post ID
maintenance.namePostIdOff: Currently naming by the platform media ID, so images from one post are not grouped and the detail page has no pager.
maintenance.namePostIdOn: Currently naming by post ID plus page number (e.g. x_1890123_p0), so images from one post get P1/P2 paging on the detail page.
maintenance.namingDescription: How media scraped from X, Misskey and Fanbox is named. Applies to future syncs only.
maintenance.rebuildDescription: Rebuild the index from metadata JSON, optionally regenerating preview cache too.
maintenance.videoDescription: Caps the size of archived videos so one long clip cannot fill the disk.

pixiv.backupLoginHint: Backup login entry; this is not a callback.
pixiv.cliLoginHint: If you do not want to enter your Pixiv password on the page, run this on the server or your own machine:
pixiv.cliTokenHint: Tokens starting with a dash can be pasted directly; for CLI sync, use --refresh-token=... or an environment variable.
pixiv.cookieLabelPlaceholder: Label, e.g. main browser session / backup

pixiv.encryptionEnabled: Deployment key is enabled: saved Pixiv Token/Cookie and proxy passwords are encrypted at rest and only masked in the UI.

pixiv.localImportHint: You can import PixivBatchDownloader-named files from the upload page first; metadata manifest import will be wired later.
pixiv.manualOauthHint: Manual callback/code exchange is only a fallback. Pixiv redirects may stop at post-redirect or third-party callbacks; for stable use, return to OAuth and run the local browser login helper.

oauthHints.code: Recognized as a code; it can be exchanged for a Token.

oauthHints.login: This is the login entry. Open it, finish Pixiv login, then copy the callback.
oauthHints.post_redirect: This is a Pixiv redirect page. Continue Pixiv redirect will reopen that page.
oauthHints.start: This is a Pixiv start page; NyaGallery cannot submit it directly. A final callback or code is required.
oauthHints.third_party: This is a third-party callback and does not belong to this NyaGallery OAuth flow.
oauthHints.unknown: Unrecognized content: a final callback URL or code is required.

faq.description: NyaGallery is a self-hosted gallery for archiving Pixiv and locally uploaded images. It keeps originals intact and manages personal collections with tags, search, preview cache, and permissions.

featureItems.auth: Password login, cookie sessions, API tokens, permissions, and security limits.
featureItems.media: AVIF/WEBP preview cache, animated previews, transcode progress, and upload logs.
featureItems.tags: Szurubooru-style tags, aliases, autocomplete, and filename search.
